title: Each role definition declares exactly its contract's tools, and an empty declaration fails the check
statement: Every shipped role definition declares an explicit tool list, and that list equals the one its role's contract derives. The role-definition check fails a definition whose tool declaration is missing or empty, and a definition that declares no tools is never treated as inheriting the agent's default active set.
notes: Amended 2026-09-18 under TSK-0051, before implementation. This criterion previously opened with "a real Pi run of each specialist reports an active tool set equal to the intersection of that role's declared allowlist and the measured host registry". That sentence needs a child process, and TSK-0051 owns only the role definitions and their static check. The measurement moved to ACC-0076, which already measures what a real child reports and already belongs to TSK-0053. What remains here is testable the moment the three definitions exist: they are generated, so the declared list is the contract's list by construction and a `--check` mode compares the generated bytes in every CI cell.
